title: Burnham hands secret missile technology to Ukraine in first foreign trip - The Latest
byline: Zoe Hitch, Lucy Hough, Luke Harding, Bryony Moore, Ryan Ramgobin
excerpt: Andy Burnham is making his first foreign visit as prime minister to Ukraine, marking the country’s independence day. Lucy Hough speaks to senior international correspondent Luke Harding
content_html: Andy Burnham is making his first foreign visit as prime minister to Ukraine, marking the country’s independence day. Burnham will use the trip to announce that the UK government will declassify information about missiles to help Ukraine build its own. Lucy Hough speaks to senior international correspondent Luke Harding – watch on YouTube
